provenance.source: Authenticated Japanese ELF and M13 continuous observation; rows decoded by the existing M13 R5900 decoder.
limitations: Observed bounded path only; interpreter and C equivalence are separate runtime checks.
The private decoder renders sq/sd/lq/ld, COP1 and MMI words as ???; bytes are authoritative and the store widths are stated in the 00198f60 interpretation.

functions.name: pre_dispatch_sprite_service_00198f60
functions.interpretation: Observed twelve-record path reconstructed as hg_pre_dispatch_service. Phase +0c of each 0039e960 record persists across frames. Packet headers store bytes 0-1 (sh), 3 (sb) and 4-7 (sw) only; each 0x40-byte quad packet stores sq $zero at +10, sw at +1c and 64-bit sd at +20/+28/+30/+38 (001991c0..d4, 001992a0..b4, 001993d0..e4). 0014f060 also receives non-ABI t0=70000ba0, t1=ctx+5b0, t2=record+18; 00152e90 receives a2=final 0x30 packet address and a3=ctx. Other array shapes fail closed.
